v1_v2_isolation.regression_gate: NORMATIVE (procedural): both CI jobs must be green for the PR, with the tested commit/tree recorded and related to the reviewed head per ci_evidence_identity: `Validate repository` (ci.yml, runs scripts/test.sh = full suite minus integration/requires_runtime/requires_docker/requires_prometheus/requires_network markers) and `AgentReview release gates` (ci.yml, runs scripts/ci_validate.sh: section 8 same selection, section 9 the requires_network tests, which include v2 content-extraction/redaction E2E, diff acquisition, transport, isolated executor and trusted-check tests). GitHub enforces nothing here: master has required_status_checks=null, required_pull_request_reviews=null and no rulesets (observed 2026-09-30), so this gate is enforced by the campaign's PRE_MERGE_GATE, not by the forge. gate_unavailable on GitHub runners (non-root): v2 tests that skip without root, sudo broker, unprivileged user namespaces, casefold tmpfs, POSIX ACLs, inotify or mknod (test_c3_focal_obligations, test_isolated_executor_v2, test_physical_snapshot_v2, test_target_pack_epoch*_v2, test_trusted_*_v2). A slice that changes a shared_v1_owned path must additionally run the full suite locally and report which of those tests ran or skipped; it may not claim them as passed. A local v1 subset is iteration convenience only.
v1_v2_isolation.collection_preservation: NORMATIVE (procedural): the slice PR records `pytest --collect-only -q` node IDs under the CI marker selection on base and head; any node ID present on base and absent on head is STOP unless the task contract names it. Changed or added test files must not define `pytest_plugins` or `pytest_*` hook functions. This closes test-selection tampering (e.g. a test module registering itself as a plugin to deselect v2 tests), which the file-level scope check cannot see.
v1_v2_isolation.residual_limitation: v1/v2 isolation is NOT statically proven. It is carried by positive write scope (C1), policy immutability (C2), no new v2 dependency (C3), shared-path justification (C4), collection preservation, the full-suite regression_gate (behavioral, bounded by existing v2 test coverage and runner gate_unavailable tests) and independent review of each slice diff. A change to a v1_exclusive module that alters v2 behavior through an existing undetected path and no v2 test would not be caught.
v1_v2_isolation.principle: isolation rests on positive write scope and behavioral full-suite evidence; no v1/v2 classifier of the tree carries the gate (every classifier attempted in review proved incomplete)
v1_v2_isolation.executable_checker_removed: An executable scope checker (evidence/v1_scope_check.py) was prototyped in this slice and removed after five consecutive post-READY Codex rounds each found a new P2 in it (scope self-expansion, module-form references, fnmatch '/' crossing, self-modification of its own guard, false-blocking of admissible tests, missed v1->v2 imports). A bespoke static checker became its own unbounded verification surface inside a contract-only slice. The obligations it tried to enforce are kept in procedural_checks: C1 and C2 as deterministic git commands, C3 as explicit PR adjudication (grep is triage only), C4 as a written justification; static detection of v1->v2 reach through existing code is not claimed (see residual_limitation).

record_per_run: tested_commit_sha (the commit actually checked out, read from the job log)
ci_evidence_identity.fact: both ci.yml jobs use actions/checkout@v4 without `ref` under pull_request, so they test the synthetic merge commit refs/pull/<n>/merge, not reviewed_head_sha; ci.yml is not changed by this campaign
ci_evidence_identity.what_tree_equality_supports: if tested_tree_sha == reviewed_head tree and the merge parents are (base_sha, reviewed_head_sha), the CI evidence supports claims about the CONTENT of reviewed_head (tests over the tree). It does NOT establish commit identity or equivalence of the whole execution
ci_evidence_identity.commit_sensitive_obligations: any obligation whose outcome depends on the exact commit (git metadata, SHA-bound provenance, history) is not covered by this evidence and needs its own proof
ci_evidence_identity.procedure: PRE_MERGE_GATE records the fields above from the job logs and the fetched pull/<n>/merge ref and applies fail_closed
ci_evidence_identity.fail_closed: NORMATIVE: at PRE_MERGE_GATE, tested_tree_sha != reviewed_head tree, OR merge parents of tested_commit_sha != (base_sha, reviewed_head_sha), OR any field missing/inconsistent => the CI evidence does not relate to the reviewed head => STOP_PRE_MERGE_GATE_FAILED. (Restores the round-6 fail-closed rule that edacd39f dropped without record.)

slice_gates.golden_fixtures: any change to frozen v1 golden fixtures requires positive, reasoned justification in the PR (app/agent_review/AGENTS.md#Compatibility)
